title.narrative: Leadership for Sustainable Development in Georgia Phase II
Ledarskap för hållbar utveckling i Georgien Phase II

description.narrative: Det övergripande målet för projektet Leadership for Sustainable Development Phase II är att påskynda och skala upp företagens lokala medverkan och engagemang för att uppnå de globala målen för hållbar utveckling genom att stärka ansvarsutkrävande och skapa en bättre miljö för konstruktivt samarbete mellan intressenter.

The overall objective of the project Leadership for Sustainable Development Phase II is to accelerate and scale the local impact of business for delivering the SDGs through ambitious targets, increased accountability, enabling environments, and enhanced multi-stakeholder collaboration.

The overall objective of phase II of the LSDG project is to accelerate and scale the local impact of business for delivering the SDGs through ambitious targets, increased accountability, enabling environments, and enhanced multi-stakeholder collaboration.
Specific Objective 1: To provide a clear framework and encourage ambitious commitments to corporate sustainability and responsible business practices aligned with the corporate sustainability standards and the SDGs in Georgia.
Specific Objective 2: To support the enhancement of public policy in the field of corporate sustainability and its further implementation in Georgia, through advocacy, dialogue, and collective action around a shared agenda.
Specific Objective 3: To ensure organizational development and sustainability of the UN Global Compact Network Georgia, enabling the organization to effectively promote corporate sustainability and business involvement in the implementation of Agenda 2030 in Georgia.
